<ns0:section style="-uslm-lc:I80" id="id9c069100-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9913"><ns0:num value="9913">§ 9913.</ns0:num><ns0:heading> Training, technical assistance, and other activities</ns0:heading><ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069101-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9913/a"><ns0:num value="a" class="bold">(a)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Activities</ns0:heading><ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069102-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9913/a/1"><ns0:num value="1" class="bold">(1)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> In general</ns0:heading><ns0:chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">The Secretary shall use amounts reserved in <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9903/b/2">section 9903(b)(2) of this title</ns0:ref>—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c069103-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9913/a/1/A"><ns0:num value="A">(A)</ns0:num><ns0:content> for training, technical assistance, planning, evaluation, and performance measurement, to assist States in carrying out corrective action activities and monitoring (to correct programmatic deficiencies of eligible entities), and for reporting and data collection activities, related to programs carried out under this chapter; and</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c069104-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9913/a/1/B"><ns0:num value="B">(B)</ns0:num><ns0:content> to distribute amounts in accordance with subsection (c).</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069105-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9913/a/2"><ns0:num value="2" class="bold">(2)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Grants, contracts, and cooperative agreements</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">The activities described in paragraph (1)(A) may be carried out by the Secretary through grants, contracts, or cooperative agreements with appropriate entities.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069106-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9913/b"><ns0:num value="b" class="bold">(b)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Terms and technical assistance process</ns0:heading><ns0:chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0">The process for determining the training and technical assistance to be carried out under this section shall—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c069107-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9913/b/1"><ns0:num value="1">(1)</ns0:num><ns0:content> ensure that the needs of eligible entities and programs relating to improving program quality (including quality of financial management practices) are addressed to the maximum extent feasible; and</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c069108-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9913/b/2"><ns0:num value="2">(2)</ns0:num><ns0:content> incorporate mechanisms to ensure responsiveness to local needs, including an ongoing procedure for obtaining input from the national and State networks of eligible entities.</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069109-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9913/c"><ns0:num value="c" class="bold">(c)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Distribution requirement</ns0:heading><ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c06910a-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9913/c/1"><ns0:num value="1" class="bold">(1)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> In general</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">The amounts reserved under <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9903/b/2/A">section 9903(b)(2)(A) of this title</ns0:ref> for activities to be carried out under this subsection shall be distributed directly to eligible entities, organizations, or associations described in paragraph (2) for the purpose of improving program quality (including quality of financial management practices), management information and reporting systems, and measurement of program results, and for the purpose of ensuring responsiveness to identified local needs.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c06910b-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9913/c/2"><ns0:num value="2" class="bold">(2)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Eligible entities, organizations, or associations</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">Eligible entities, organizations, or associations described in this paragraph shall be eligible entities, or statewide or local organizations or associations, with demonstrated expertise in providing training to individuals and organizations on methods of effectively addressing the needs of low-income families and communities.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:sourceCredit id="id9c06910c-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc">(<ns0:ref href="/us/pl/97/35/tVI/s678A">Pub. L. 97–35, title VI, § 678A</ns0:ref>, as added <ns0:ref href="/us/pl/105/285/tII/s201">Pub. L. 105–285, title II, § 201</ns0:ref>, <ns0:date date="1998-10-27">Oct. 27, 1998</ns0:date>, <ns0:ref href="/us/stat/112/2742">112 Stat. 2742</ns0:ref>.)</ns0:sourceCredit>
</ns0:section>
<ns0:section style="-uslm-lc:I80" id="id9c06910d-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9914"><ns0:num value="9914">§ 9914.</ns0:num><ns0:heading> Monitoring of eligible entities</ns0:heading><ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c06910e-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9914/a"><ns0:num value="a" class="bold">(a)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> In general</ns0:heading><ns0:chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0">In order to determine whether eligible entities meet the performance goals, administrative standards, financial management requirements, and other requirements of a State, the State shall conduct the following reviews of eligible entities:</ns0:chapeau><ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c06910f-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9914/a/1"><ns0:num value="1">(1)</ns0:num><ns0:content> A full onsite review of each such entity at least once during each 3-year period.</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c069110-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9914/a/2"><ns0:num value="2">(2)</ns0:num><ns0:content> An onsite review of each newly designated entity immediately after the completion of the first year in which such entity receives funds through the community services block grant program.</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c069111-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9914/a/3"><ns0:num value="3">(3)</ns0:num><ns0:content> Followup reviews including prompt return visits to eligible entities, and their programs, that fail to meet the goals, standards, and requirements established by the State.</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c069112-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9914/a/4"><ns0:num value="4">(4)</ns0:num><ns0:content> Other reviews as appropriate, including reviews of entities with programs that have had other Federal, State, or local grants (other than assistance provided under this chapter) terminated for cause.</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069113-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9914/b"><ns0:num value="b" class="bold">(b)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Requests</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0">The State may request training and technical assistance from the Secretary as needed to comply with the requirements of this section.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069114-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9914/c"><ns0:num value="c" class="bold">(c)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Evaluations by the Secretary</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0">The Secretary shall conduct in several States in each fiscal year evaluations (including investigations) of the use of funds received by the States under this chapter in order to evaluate compliance with the provisions of this chapter, and especially with respect to compliance with <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9908/b">section 9908(b) of this title</ns0:ref>. The Secretary shall submit, to each State evaluated, a report containing the results of such evaluations, and recommendations of improvements designed to enhance the benefit and impact of the activities carried out with such funds for people in need. On receiving the report, the State shall submit to the Secretary a plan of action in response to the recommendations contained in the report. The results of the evaluations shall be submitted annually to the Chairperson of the Committee on Education and the Workforce of the House of Representatives and the Chairperson of the Committee on Labor and Human Resources of the Senate as part of the report submitted by the Secretary in accordance with <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9917/b/2">section 9917(b)(2) of this title</ns0:ref>.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:sourceCredit id="id9c069115-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc">(<ns0:ref href="/us/pl/97/35/tVI/s678B">Pub. L. 97–35, title VI, § 678B</ns0:ref>, as added <ns0:ref href="/us/pl/105/285/tII/s201">Pub. L. 105–285, title II, § 201</ns0:ref>, <ns0:date date="1998-10-27">Oct. 27, 1998</ns0:date>, <ns0:ref href="/us/stat/112/2743">112 Stat. 2743</ns0:ref>.)</ns0:sourceCredit>
<ns0:notes type="uscNote" id="id9c069116-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc">
<ns0:note style="-uslm-lc:I74" role="crossHeading" topic="statutoryNotes" id="id9c069117-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc"><ns0:heading class="centered"><ns0:b>Statutory Notes and Related Subsidiaries</ns0:b></ns0:heading></ns0:note>
<ns0:note style="-uslm-lc:I78" topic="changeOfName" id="id9c069118-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc">
<ns0:heading class="centered smallCaps">Change of Name</ns0:heading>
<ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">Committee on Labor and Human Resources of Senate changed to Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions of Senate by Senate Resolution No. 20, One Hundred Sixth Congress, <ns0:date date="1999-01-19">Jan. 19, 1999</ns0:date>.</ns0:p>
</ns0:note>
</ns0:notes>
</ns0:section>
<ns0:section style="-uslm-lc:I80" id="id9c069119-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9915"><ns0:num value="9915">§ 9915.</ns0:num><ns0:heading> Corrective action; termination and reduction of funding</ns0:heading><ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c06911a-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9915/a"><ns0:num value="a" class="bold">(a)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Determination</ns0:heading><ns0:chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0">If the State determines, on the basis of a final decision in a review pursuant to <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9914">section 9914 of this title</ns0:ref>, that an eligible entity fails to comply with the terms of an agreement, or the State plan, to provide services under this chapter or to meet appropriate standards, goals, and other requirements established by the State (including performance objectives), the State shall—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c06911b-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9915/a/1"><ns0:num value="1">(1)</ns0:num><ns0:content> inform the entity of the deficiency to be corrected;</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c06911c-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9915/a/2"><ns0:num value="2">(2)</ns0:num><ns0:content> require the entity to correct the deficiency;</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c06911d-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9915/a/3"><ns0:num value="3">(3)</ns0:num><ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c06911e-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9915/a/3/A"><ns0:num value="A">(A)</ns0:num><ns0:content> offer training and technical assistance, if appropriate, to help correct the deficiency, and prepare and submit to the Secretary a report describing the training and technical assistance offered; or</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c06911f-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9915/a/3/B"><ns0:num value="B">(B)</ns0:num><ns0:content> if the State determines that such training and technical assistance are not appropriate, prepare and submit to the Secretary a report stating the reasons for the determination;</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c069120-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9915/a/4"><ns0:num value="4">(4)</ns0:num><ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c069121-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9915/a/4/A"><ns0:num value="A">(A)</ns0:num><ns0:content> at the discretion of the State (taking into account the seriousness of the deficiency and the time reasonably required to correct the deficiency), allow the entity to develop and implement, within 60 days after being informed of the deficiency, a quality improvement plan to correct such deficiency within a reasonable period of time, as determined by the State; and</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c069122-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9915/a/4/B"><ns0:num value="B">(B)</ns0:num><ns0:content> not later than 30 days after receiving from an eligible entity a proposed quality improvement plan pursuant to subparagraph (A), either approve such proposed plan or specify the reasons why the proposed plan cannot be approved; and</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c069123-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9915/a/5"><ns0:num value="5">(5)</ns0:num><ns0:content> after providing adequate notice and an opportunity for a hearing, initiate proceedings to terminate the designation of or reduce the funding under this chapter of the eligible entity unless the entity corrects the deficiency.</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069124-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9915/b"><ns0:num value="b" class="bold">(b)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Review</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0">A determination to terminate the designation or reduce the funding of an eligible entity is reviewable by the Secretary. The Secretary shall, upon request, review such a determination. The review shall be completed not later than 90 days after the Secretary receives from the State all necessary documentation relating to the determination to terminate the designation or reduce the funding. If the review is not completed within 90 days, the determination of the State shall become final at the end of the 90th day.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069125-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9915/c"><ns0:num value="c" class="bold">(c)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Direct assistance</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0">Whenever a State violates the assurances contained in <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9908/b/8">section 9908(b)(8) of this title</ns0:ref> and terminates or reduces the funding of an eligible entity prior to the completion of the State hearing described in that section and the Secretary’s review as required in subsection (b), the Secretary is authorized to provide financial assistance under this chapter to the eligible entity affected until the violation is corrected. In such a case, the grant or allotment for the State under section 9905 or 9906 of this title for the earliest appropriate fiscal year shall be reduced by an amount equal to the funds provided under this subsection to such eligible entity.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:sourceCredit id="id9c069126-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc">(<ns0:ref href="/us/pl/97/35/tVI/s678C">Pub. L. 97–35, title VI, § 678C</ns0:ref>, as added <ns0:ref href="/us/pl/105/285/tII/s201">Pub. L. 105–285, title II, § 201</ns0:ref>, <ns0:date date="1998-10-27">Oct. 27, 1998</ns0:date>, <ns0:ref href="/us/stat/112/2743">112 Stat. 2743</ns0:ref>.)</ns0:sourceCredit>
</ns0:section>
<ns0:section style="-uslm-lc:I80" id="id9c069127-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9916"><ns0:num value="9916">§ 9916.</ns0:num><ns0:heading> Fiscal controls, audits, and withholding</ns0:heading><ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069128-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9916/a"><ns0:num value="a" class="bold">(a)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Fiscal controls, procedures, audits, and inspections</ns0:heading><ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069129-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9916/a/1"><ns0:num value="1" class="bold">(1)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> In general</ns0:heading><ns0:chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">A State that receives funds under this chapter shall—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c06912a-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9916/a/1/A"><ns0:num value="A">(A)</ns0:num><ns0:content> establish fiscal control and fund accounting procedures necessary to assure the proper disbursal of and accounting for Federal funds paid to the State under this chapter, including procedures for monitoring the funds provided under this chapter;</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c06912b-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9916/a/1/B"><ns0:num value="B">(B)</ns0:num><ns0:content> ensure that cost and accounting standards of the Office of Management and Budget apply to a recipient of the funds under this chapter;</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c06912c-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9916/a/1/C"><ns0:num value="C">(C)</ns0:num><ns0:content> subject to paragraph (2), prepare, at least every year, an audit of the expenditures of the State of amounts received under this chapter and amounts transferred to carry out the purposes of this chapter; and</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c06912d-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9916/a/1/D"><ns0:num value="D">(D)</ns0:num><ns0:content> make appropriate books, documents, papers, and records available to the Secretary and the Comptroller General of the United States, or any of their duly authorized representatives, for examination, copying, or mechanical reproduction on or off the premises of the appropriate entity upon a reasonable request for the items.</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c06912e-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9916/a/2"><ns0:num value="2" class="bold">(2)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Audits</ns0:heading><ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I18" class="indent4 firstIndent-2" id="id9c06912f-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9916/a/2/A"><ns0:num value="A" class="bold">(A)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> In general</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2">Subject to subparagraph (B), each audit required by subsection (a)(1)(C) shall be conducted by an entity independent of any agency administering activities or services carried out under this chapter and shall be conducted in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I18" class="indent4 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069130-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9916/a/2/B"><ns0:num value="B" class="bold">(B)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Single audit requirements</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2">Audits shall be conducted under this paragraph in the manner and to the extent provided in chapter 75 of title 31 (commonly known as the “Single Audit Act Amendments of 1996”).</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I18" class="indent4 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069131-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9916/a/2/C"><ns0:num value="C" class="bold">(C)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Submission of copies</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2">Within 30 days after the completion of each such audit in a State, the chief executive officer of the State shall submit a copy of such audit to any eligible entity that was the subject of the audit at no charge, to the legislature of the State, and to the Secretary.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069132-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9916/a/3"><ns0:num value="3" class="bold">(3)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Repayments</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">The State shall repay to the United States amounts found not to have been expended in accordance with this chapter or the Secretary may offset such amounts against any other amount to which the State is or may become entitled under this chapter.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069133-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9916/b"><ns0:num value="b" class="bold">(b)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Withholding</ns0:heading><ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069134-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9916/b/1"><ns0:num value="1" class="bold">(1)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> In general</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">The Secretary shall, after providing adequate notice and an opportunity for a hearing conducted within the affected State, withhold funds from any State that does not utilize the grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title in accordance with the provisions of this chapter, including the assurances such State provided under <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9908">section 9908 of this title</ns0:ref>.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069135-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9916/b/2"><ns0:num value="2" class="bold">(2)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Response to complaints</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">The Secretary shall respond in an expeditious and speedy manner to complaints of a substantial or serious nature that a State has failed to use funds in accordance with the provisions of this chapter, including the assurances provided by the State under <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9908">section 9908 of this title</ns0:ref>. For purposes of this paragraph, a complaint of a failure to meet any one of the assurances provided under <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9908">section 9908 of this title</ns0:ref> that constitutes disregarding that assurance shall be considered to be a complaint of a serious nature.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069136-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9916/b/3"><ns0:num value="3" class="bold">(3)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Investigations</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">Whenever the Secretary determines that there is a pattern of complaints of failures described in paragraph (2) from any State in any fiscal year, the Secretary shall conduct an investigation of the use of funds received under this chapter by such State in order to ensure compliance with the provisions of this chapter.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:sourceCredit id="id9c069137-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc">(<ns0:ref href="/us/pl/97/35/tVI/s678D">Pub. L. 97–35, title VI, § 678D</ns0:ref>, as added <ns0:ref href="/us/pl/105/285/tII/s201">Pub. L. 105–285, title II, § 201</ns0:ref>, <ns0:date date="1998-10-27">Oct. 27, 1998</ns0:date>, <ns0:ref href="/us/stat/112/2744">112 Stat. 2744</ns0:ref>.)</ns0:sourceCredit>
</ns0:section>
<ns0:section style="-uslm-lc:I80" id="id9c069138-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9917"><ns0:num value="9917">§ 9917.</ns0:num><ns0:heading> Accountability and reporting requirements</ns0:heading><ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069139-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9917/a"><ns0:num value="a" class="bold">(a)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> State accountability and reporting requirements</ns0:heading><ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c06913a-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9917/a/1"><ns0:num value="1" class="bold">(1)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Performance measurement</ns0:heading><ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I18" class="indent4 firstIndent-2" id="id9c06913b-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9917/a/1/A"><ns0:num value="A" class="bold">(A)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> In general</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2">By <ns0:date date="2001-10-01">October 1, 2001</ns0:date>, each State that receives funds under this chapter shall participate, and shall ensure that all eligible entities in the State participate, in a performance measurement system, which may be a performance measurement system for which the Secretary facilitated development pursuant to subsection (b), or an alternative system that the Secretary is satisfied meets the requirements of subsection (b).</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I18" class="indent4 firstIndent-2" id="id9c06913c-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9917/a/1/B"><ns0:num value="B" class="bold">(B)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Local agencies</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2">The State may elect to have local agencies that are subcontractors of the eligible entities under this chapter participate in the performance measurement system. If the State makes that election, references in this section to eligible entities shall be considered to include the local agencies.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c06913d-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9917/a/2"><ns0:num value="2" class="bold">(2)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Annual report</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">Each State shall annually prepare and submit to the Secretary a report on the measured performance of the State and the eligible entities in the State. Prior to the participation of the State in the performance measurement system, the State shall include in the report any information collected by the State relating to such performance. Each State shall also include in the report an accounting of the expenditure of funds received by the State through the community services block grant program, including an accounting of funds spent on administrative costs by the State and the eligible entities, and funds spent by eligible entities on the direct delivery of local services, and shall include information on the number of and characteristics of clients served under this chapter in the State, based on data collected from the eligible entities. The State shall also include in the report a summary describing the training and technical assistance offered by the State under <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9915/a/3">section 9915(a)(3) of this title</ns0:ref> during the year covered by the report.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c06913e-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9917/b"><ns0:num value="b" class="bold">(b)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Secretary’s accountability and reporting requirements</ns0:heading><ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c06913f-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9917/b/1"><ns0:num value="1" class="bold">(1)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Performance measurement</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">The Secretary, in collaboration with the States and with eligible entities throughout the Nation, shall facilitate the development of one or more model performance measurement systems, which may be used by the States and by eligible entities to measure their performance in carrying out the requirements of this chapter and in achieving the goals of their community action plans. The Secretary shall provide technical assistance, including support for the enhancement of electronic data systems, to States and to eligible entities to enhance their capability to collect and report data for such a system and to aid in their participation in such a system.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069140-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9917/b/2"><ns0:num value="2" class="bold">(2)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Reporting requirements</ns0:heading><ns0:chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">At the end of each fiscal year beginning after <ns0:date date="1999-09-30">September 30, 1999</ns0:date>, the Secretary shall, directly or by grant or contract, prepare a report containing—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c069141-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9917/b/2/A"><ns0:num value="A">(A)</ns0:num><ns0:content> a summary of the planned use of funds by each State, and the eligible entities in the State, under the community services block grant program, as contained in each State plan submitted pursuant to <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9908">section 9908 of this title</ns0:ref>;</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c069142-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9917/b/2/B"><ns0:num value="B">(B)</ns0:num><ns0:content> a description of how funds were actually spent by the State and eligible entities in the State, including a breakdown of funds spent on administrative costs and on the direct delivery of local services by eligible entities;</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c069143-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9917/b/2/C"><ns0:num value="C">(C)</ns0:num><ns0:content> information on the number of entities eligible for funds under this chapter, the number of low-income persons served under this chapter, and such demographic data on the low-income populations served by eligible entities as is determined by the Secretary to be feasible;</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c069144-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9917/b/2/D"><ns0:num value="D">(D)</ns0:num><ns0:content> a comparison of the planned uses of funds for each State and the actual uses of the funds;</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c069145-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9917/b/2/E"><ns0:num value="E">(E)</ns0:num><ns0:content> a summary of each State’s performance results, and the results for the eligible entities, as collected and submitted by the States in accordance with subsection (a)(2); and</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c069146-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9917/b/2/F"><ns0:num value="F">(F)</ns0:num><ns0:content> any additional information that the Secretary considers to be appropriate to carry out this chapter, if the Secretary informs the States of the need for such additional information and allows a reasonable period of time for the States to collect and provide the information.</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069147-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9917/b/3"><ns0:num value="3" class="bold">(3)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Submission</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">The Secretary shall submit to the Committee on Education and the Workforce of the House of Representatives and the Committee on Labor and Human Resources of the Senate the report described in paragraph (2), and any comments the Secretary may have with respect to such report. The report shall include definitions of direct and administrative costs used by the Department of Health and Human Services for programs funded under this chapter.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069148-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9917/b/4"><ns0:num value="4" class="bold">(4)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Costs</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">Of the funds reserved under <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9903/b/3">section 9903(b)(3) of this title</ns0:ref>, not more than $350,000 shall be available to carry out the reporting requirements contained in paragraph (2).</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:sourceCredit id="id9c069149-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc">(<ns0:ref href="/us/pl/97/35/tVI/s678E">Pub. L. 97–35, title VI, § 678E</ns0:ref>, as added <ns0:ref href="/us/pl/105/285/tII/s201">Pub. L. 105–285, title II, § 201</ns0:ref>, <ns0:date date="1998-10-27">Oct. 27, 1998</ns0:date>, <ns0:ref href="/us/stat/112/2746">112 Stat. 2746</ns0:ref>.)</ns0:sourceCredit>
<ns0:notes type="uscNote" id="id9c06914a-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc">
<ns0:note style="-uslm-lc:I74" role="crossHeading" topic="statutoryNotes" id="id9c06914b-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc"><ns0:heading class="centered"><ns0:b>Statutory Notes and Related Subsidiaries</ns0:b></ns0:heading></ns0:note>
<ns0:note style="-uslm-lc:I78" topic="changeOfName" id="id9c06914c-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc">
<ns0:heading class="centered smallCaps">Change of Name</ns0:heading>
<ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">Committee on Labor and Human Resources of Senate changed to Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions of Senate by Senate Resolution No. 20, One Hundred Sixth Congress, <ns0:date date="1999-01-19">Jan. 19, 1999</ns0:date>.</ns0:p>
</ns0:note>
</ns0:notes>
</ns0:section>
<ns0:section style="-uslm-lc:I80" id="id9c06914d-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9918"><ns0:num value="9918">§ 9918.</ns0:num><ns0:heading> Limitations on use of funds</ns0:heading><ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c06914e-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9918/a"><ns0:num value="a" class="bold">(a)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Construction of facilities</ns0:heading><ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c06914f-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9918/a/1"><ns0:num value="1" class="bold">(1)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Limitations</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">Except as provided in paragraph (2), grants made under this chapter (other than amounts reserved under <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9903/b/3">section 9903(b)(3) of this title</ns0:ref>) may not be used by the State, or by any other person with which the State makes arrangements to carry out the purposes of this chapter, for the purchase or improvement of land, or the purchase, construction, or permanent improvement (other than low-cost residential weatherization or other energy-related home repairs) of any building or other facility.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069150-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9918/a/2"><ns0:num value="2" class="bold">(2)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Waiver</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">The Secretary may waive the limitation contained in paragraph (1) upon a State request for such a waiver, if the Secretary finds that the request describes extraordinary circumstances to justify the purchase of land or the construction of facilities (or the making of permanent improvements) and that permitting the waiver will contribute to the ability of the State to carry out the purposes of this chapter.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069151-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9918/b"><ns0:num value="b" class="bold">(b)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Political activities</ns0:heading><ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069152-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9918/b/1"><ns0:num value="1" class="bold">(1)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Treatment as a State or local agency</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">For purposes of chapter 15 of title 5, any entity that assumes responsibility for planning, developing, and coordinating activities under this chapter and receives assistance under this chapter shall be deemed to be a State or local agency. For purposes of paragraphs (1) and (2) of section 1502(a) of such title, any entity receiving assistance under this chapter shall be deemed to be a State or local agency.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069153-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9918/b/2"><ns0:num value="2" class="bold">(2)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Prohibitions</ns0:heading><ns0:chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">Programs assisted under this chapter shall not be carried on in a manner involving the use of program funds, the provision of services, or the employment or assignment of personnel, in a manner supporting or resulting in the identification of such programs with—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c069154-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9918/b/2/A"><ns0:num value="A">(A)</ns0:num><ns0:content> any partisan or nonpartisan political activity or any political activity associated with a candidate, or contending faction or group, in an election for public or party office;</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c069155-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9918/b/2/B"><ns0:num value="B">(B)</ns0:num><ns0:content> any activity to provide voters or prospective voters with transportation to the polls or similar assistance in connection with any such election; or</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c069156-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9918/b/2/C"><ns0:num value="C">(C)</ns0:num><ns0:content> any voter registration activity.</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069157-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9918/b/3"><ns0:num value="3" class="bold">(3)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Rules and regulations</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">The Secretary, after consultation with the Office of Personnel Management, shall issue rules and regulations to provide for the enforcement of this subsection, which shall include provisions for summary suspension of assistance or other action necessary to permit enforcement on an emergency basis.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069158-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9918/c"><ns0:num value="c" class="bold">(c)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Nondiscrimination</ns0:heading><ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069159-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9918/c/1"><ns0:num value="1" class="bold">(1)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> In general</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">No person shall, on the basis of race, color, national origin, or sex be excluded from participation in, be denied the benefits of, or be subjected to discrimination under, any program or activity funded in whole or in part with funds made available under this chapter. Any prohibition against discrimination on the basis of age under the Age Discrimination Act of 1975 (<ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s6101">42 U.S.C. 6101</ns0:ref> et seq.) or with respect to an otherwise qualified individual with a disability as provided in section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973 (<ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t29/s794">29 U.S.C. 794</ns0:ref>), or title II of the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990 (<ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s12131">42 U.S.C. 12131</ns0:ref> et seq.) shall also apply to any such program or activity.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c06915a-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9918/c/2"><ns0:num value="2" class="bold">(2)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Action of Secretary</ns0:heading><ns0:chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">Whenever the Secretary determines that a State that has received a payment under this chapter has failed to comply with paragraph (1) or an applicable regulation, the Secretary shall notify the chief executive officer of the State and shall request that the officer secure compliance. If within a reasonable period of time, not to exceed 60 days, the chief executive officer fails or refuses to secure compliance, the Secretary is authorized to—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c06915b-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9918/c/2/A"><ns0:num value="A">(A)</ns0:num><ns0:content> refer the matter to the Attorney General with a recommendation that an appropriate civil action be instituted;</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c06915c-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9918/c/2/B"><ns0:num value="B">(B)</ns0:num><ns0:content> exercise the powers and functions provided by title VI of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 (<ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s2000d">42 U.S.C. 2000d</ns0:ref> et seq.), the Age Discrimination Act of 1975 (<ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s6101">42 U.S.C. 6101</ns0:ref> et seq.), section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973 (<ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t29/s794">29 U.S.C. 794</ns0:ref>), or title II of the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990 (<ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s12131">42 U.S.C. 12131</ns0:ref> et seq.), as may be applicable; or</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c06915d-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9918/c/2/C"><ns0:num value="C">(C)</ns0:num><ns0:content> take such other action as may be provided by law.</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c06915e-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9918/c/3"><ns0:num value="3" class="bold">(3)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Action of Attorney General</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">When a matter is referred to the Attorney General pursuant to paragraph (2), or whenever the Attorney General has reason to believe that the State is engaged in a pattern or practice of discrimination in violation of the provisions of this subsection, the Attorney General may bring a civil action in any appropriate United States district court for such relief as may be appropriate, including injunctive relief.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:sourceCredit id="id9c06915f-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc">(<ns0:ref href="/us/pl/97/35/tVI/s678F">Pub. L. 97–35, title VI, § 678F</ns0:ref>, as added <ns0:ref href="/us/pl/105/285/tII/s201">Pub. L. 105–285, title II, § 201</ns0:ref>, <ns0:date date="1998-10-27">Oct. 27, 1998</ns0:date>, <ns0:ref href="/us/stat/112/2747">112 Stat. 2747</ns0:ref>.)</ns0:sourceCredit>
<ns0:notes type="uscNote" id="id9c069160-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc">

</ns0:notes>
</ns0:section>
<ns0:section style="-uslm-lc:I80" id="id9c069163-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9919"><ns0:num value="9919">§ 9919.</ns0:num><ns0:heading> Drug and child support services and referrals</ns0:heading><ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069164-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9919/a"><ns0:num value="a" class="bold">(a)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Drug testing and rehabilitation</ns0:heading><ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069165-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9919/a/1"><ns0:num value="1" class="bold">(1)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> In general</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">Nothing in this chapter shall be construed to prohibit a State from testing participants in programs, activities, or services carried out or provided under this chapter for controlled substances. A State that conducts such testing shall inform the participants who test positive for any of such substances about the availability of treatment or rehabilitation services and refer such participants for appropriate treatment or rehabilitation services.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069166-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9919/a/2"><ns0:num value="2" class="bold">(2)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Administrative expenses</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">Any funds provided under this chapter expended for such testing shall be considered to be expended for administrative expenses and shall be subject to the limitation specified in <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9907/b/2">section 9907(b)(2) of this title</ns0:ref>.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069167-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9919/a/3"><ns0:num value="3" class="bold">(3)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Definition</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">In this subsection, the term “controlled substance” has the meaning given the term in <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t21/s802">section 802 of title 21</ns0:ref>.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069168-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9919/b"><ns0:num value="b" class="bold">(b)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Child support services and referrals</ns0:heading><ns0:chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0">During each fiscal year for which an eligible entity receives a grant under <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9907">section 9907 of this title</ns0:ref>, such entity shall—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c069169-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9919/b/1"><ns0:num value="1">(1)</ns0:num><ns0:content> inform custodial parents in single-parent families that participate in programs, activities, or services carried out or provided under this chapter about the availability of child support services; and</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id9c06916a-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9919/b/2"><ns0:num value="2">(2)</ns0:num><ns0:content> refer eligible parents to the child support offices of State and local governments.</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:sourceCredit id="id9c06916b-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc">(<ns0:ref href="/us/pl/97/35/tVI/s678G">Pub. L. 97–35, title VI, § 678G</ns0:ref>, as added <ns0:ref href="/us/pl/105/285/tII/s201">Pub. L. 105–285, title II, § 201</ns0:ref>, <ns0:date date="1998-10-27">Oct. 27, 1998</ns0:date>, <ns0:ref href="/us/stat/112/2749">112 Stat. 2749</ns0:ref>.)</ns0:sourceCredit>
</ns0:section>
<ns0:section style="-uslm-lc:I80" id="id9c06916c-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9920"><ns0:num value="9920">§ 9920.</ns0:num><ns0:heading> Operational rule</ns0:heading><ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c06916d-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9920/a"><ns0:num value="a" class="bold">(a)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Religious organizations included as nongovernmental providers</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0">For any program carried out by the Federal Government, or by a State or local government under this chapter, the government shall consider, on the same basis as other nongovernmental organizations, religious organizations to provide the assistance under the program, so long as the program is implemented in a manner consistent with the Establishment Clause of the first amendment to the Constitution. Neither the Federal Government nor a State or local government receiving funds under this chapter shall discriminate against an organization that provides assistance under, or applies to provide assistance under, this chapter, on the basis that the organization has a religious character.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c06916e-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9920/b"><ns0:num value="b" class="bold">(b)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Religious character and independence</ns0:heading><ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c06916f-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9920/b/1"><ns0:num value="1" class="bold">(1)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> In general</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">A religious organization that provides assistance under a program described in subsection (a) shall retain its religious character and control over the definition, development, practice, and expression of its religious beliefs.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069170-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9920/b/2"><ns0:num value="2" class="bold">(2)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Additional safeguards</ns0:heading><ns0:chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">Neither the Federal Government nor a State or local government shall require a religious organization—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c069171-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9920/b/2/A"><ns0:num value="A">(A)</ns0:num><ns0:content> to alter its form of internal governance, except (for purposes of administration of the community services block grant program) as provided in <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9910">section 9910 of this title</ns0:ref>; or</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c069172-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9920/b/2/B"><ns0:num value="B">(B)</ns0:num><ns0:content> to remove religious art, icons, scripture, or other symbols;</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>

<ns0:continuation style="-uslm-lc:I17" class="indent1 firstIndent0">in order to be eligible to provide assistance under a program described in subsection (a).</ns0:continuation>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069173-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9920/b/3"><ns0:num value="3" class="bold">(3)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Employment practices</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">A religious organization’s exemption provided under <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s2000e–1">section 2000e–1 of this title</ns0:ref> regarding employment practices shall not be affected by its participation in, or receipt of funds from, programs described in subsection (a).</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069174-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9920/c"><ns0:num value="c" class="bold">(c)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Limitations on use of funds for certain purposes</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0">No funds provided directly to a religious organization to provide assistance under any program described in subsection (a) shall be expended for sectarian worship, instruction, or proselytization.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069175-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9920/d"><ns0:num value="d" class="bold">(d)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Fiscal accountability</ns0:heading><ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069176-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9920/d/1"><ns0:num value="1" class="bold">(1)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> In general</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">Except as provided in paragraph (2), any religious organization providing assistance under any program described in subsection (a) shall be subject to the same regulations as other nongovernmental organizations to account in accord with generally accepted accounting principles for the use of such funds provided under such program.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069177-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9920/d/2"><ns0:num value="2" class="bold">(2)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Limited audit</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">Such organization shall segregate government funds provided under such program into a separate account. Only the government funds shall be subject to audit by the government.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069178-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9920/e"><ns0:num value="e" class="bold">(e)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Treatment of eligible entities and other intermediate organizations</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0">If an eligible entity or other organization (referred to in this subsection as an “intermediate organization”), acting under a contract, or grant or other agreement, with the Federal Government or a State or local government, is given the authority under the contract or agreement to select nongovernmental organizations to provide assistance under the programs described in subsection (a), the intermediate organization shall have the same duties under this section as the government.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:sourceCredit id="id9c069179-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc">(<ns0:ref href="/us/pl/97/35/tVI/s679">Pub. L. 97–35, title VI, § 679</ns0:ref>, as added <ns0:ref href="/us/pl/105/285/tII/s201">Pub. L. 105–285, title II, § 201</ns0:ref>, <ns0:date date="1998-10-27">Oct. 27, 1998</ns0:date>, <ns0:ref href="/us/stat/112/2749">112 Stat. 2749</ns0:ref>.)</ns0:sourceCredit>
<ns0:notes type="uscNote" id="id9c06917a-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc">
<ns0:note style="-uslm-lc:I74" role="crossHeading" topic="editorialNotes" id="id9c06917b-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc"><ns0:heading class="centered"><ns0:b>Editorial Notes</ns0:b></ns0:heading></ns0:note>
<ns0:note style="-uslm-lc:I74" topic="priorProvisions" id="id9c06917c-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc"><ns0:heading class="centered smallCaps">Prior Provisions</ns0:heading><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">A prior <ns0:ref href="/us/pl/97/35/s679">section 679 of Pub. L. 97–35</ns0:ref> was classified to <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9908">section 9908 of this title</ns0:ref>, prior to the general amendment of this chapter by <ns0:ref href="/us/pl/105/285">Pub. L. 105–285</ns0:ref>.</ns0:p>
</ns0:note>
</ns0:notes>
</ns0:section>
<ns0:section style="-uslm-lc:I80" id="id9c06917d-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9921"><ns0:num value="9921">§ 9921.</ns0:num><ns0:heading> Discretionary authority of Secretary</ns0:heading><ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c06917e-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9921/a"><ns0:num value="a" class="bold">(a)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Grants, contracts, arrangements, loans, and guarantees</ns0:heading><ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c06917f-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9921/a/1"><ns0:num value="1" class="bold">(1)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> In general</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">The Secretary shall, from funds reserved under <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9903/b/3">section 9903(b)(3) of this title</ns0:ref>, make grants, loans, or guarantees to States and public agencies and private, nonprofit organizations, or enter into contracts or jointly financed cooperative arrangements with States and public agencies and private, nonprofit organizations (and for-profit organizations, to the extent specified in paragraph (2)(E)) for each of the objectives described in paragraphs (2) through (4).</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069180-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9921/a/2"><ns0:num value="2" class="bold">(2)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Community economic development</ns0:heading><ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I18" class="indent4 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069181-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9921/a/2/A"><ns0:num value="A" class="bold">(A)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Economic development activities</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2">The Secretary shall make grants described in paragraph (1) on a competitive basis to private, nonprofit organizations that are community development corporations to provide technical and financial assistance for economic development activities designed to address the economic needs of low-income individuals and families by creating employment and business development opportunities.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I18" class="indent4 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069182-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9921/a/2/B"><ns0:num value="B" class="bold">(B)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Consultation</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2">The Secretary shall exercise the authority provided under subparagraph (A) after consultation with other relevant Federal officials.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I18" class="indent4 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069183-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9921/a/2/C"><ns0:num value="C" class="bold">(C)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Governing boards</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2">For a community development corporation to receive funds to carry out this paragraph, the corporation shall be governed by a board that shall consist of residents of the community and business and civic leaders and shall have as a principal purpose planning, developing, or managing low-income housing or community development projects.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I18" class="indent4 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069184-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9921/a/2/D"><ns0:num value="D" class="bold">(D)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Geographic distribution</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2">In making grants to carry out this paragraph, the Secretary shall take into consideration the geographic distribution of funding among States and the relative proportion of funding among rural and urban areas.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I18" class="indent4 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069185-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9921/a/2/E"><ns0:num value="E" class="bold">(E)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Reservation</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2">Of the amounts made available to carry out this paragraph, the Secretary may reserve not more than 1 percent for each fiscal year to make grants to private, nonprofit organizations or to enter into contracts with private, nonprofit or for-profit organizations to provide technical assistance to aid community development corporations in developing or implementing activities funded to carry out this paragraph and to evaluate activities funded to carry out this paragraph.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069186-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9921/a/3"><ns0:num value="3" class="bold">(3)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Rural community development activities</ns0:heading><ns0:chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">The Secretary shall provide the assistance described in paragraph (1) for rural community development activities, which shall include providing—</ns0:chapeau><ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c069187-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9921/a/3/A"><ns0:num value="A">(A)</ns0:num><ns0:content> grants to private, nonprofit corporations to enable the corporations to provide assistance concerning home repair to rural low-income families and concerning planning and developing low-income rural rental housing units; and</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
<ns0:subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id9c069188-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9921/a/3/B"><ns0:num value="B">(B)</ns0:num><ns0:content> grants to multistate, regional, private, nonprofit organizations to enable the organizations to provide training and technical assistance to small, rural communities concerning meeting their community facility needs.</ns0:content>
</ns0:subparagraph>
</ns0:paragraph>
<ns0:paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id9c069189-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9921/a/4"><ns0:num value="4" class="bold">(4)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Neighborhood innovation projects</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">The Secretary shall provide the assistance described in paragraph (1) for neighborhood innovation projects, which shall include providing grants to neighborhood-based private, nonprofit organizations to test or assist in the development of new approaches or methods that will aid in overcoming special problems identified by communities or neighborhoods or otherwise assist in furthering the purposes of this chapter, and which may include providing assistance for projects that are designed to serve low-income individuals and families who are not being effectively served by other programs.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:paragraph>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c06918a-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9921/b"><ns0:num value="b" class="bold">(b)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Evaluation</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0">The Secretary shall require all activities receiving assistance under this section to be evaluated for their effectiveness. Funding for such evaluations shall be provided as a stated percentage of the assistance or through a separate grant awarded by the Secretary specifically for the purpose of evaluation of a particular activity or group of activities.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id9c06918b-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc" identifier="/us/usc/t42/s9921/c"><ns0:num value="c" class="bold">(c)</ns0:num><ns0:heading class="bold"> Annual report</ns0:heading><ns0:content><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0">The Secretary shall compile an annual report containing a summary of the evaluations required in subsection (b) and a listing of all activities assisted under this section. The Secretary shall annually submit the report to the Chairperson of the Committee on Education and the Workforce of the House of Representatives and the Chairperson of the Committee on Labor and Human Resources of the Senate.</ns0:p>
</ns0:content>
</ns0:subsection>
<ns0:sourceCredit id="id9c06918c-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc">(<ns0:ref href="/us/pl/97/35/tVI/s680">Pub. L. 97–35, title VI, § 680</ns0:ref>, as added <ns0:ref href="/us/pl/105/285/tII/s201">Pub. L. 105–285, title II, § 201</ns0:ref>, <ns0:date date="1998-10-27">Oct. 27, 1998</ns0:date>, <ns0:ref href="/us/stat/112/2750">112 Stat. 2750</ns0:ref>.)</ns0:sourceCredit>

<ns0:note style="-uslm-lc:I74" role="crossHeading" topic="editorialNotes" id="id9c06918e-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc"><ns0:heading class="centered"><ns0:b>Editorial Notes</ns0:b></ns0:heading></ns0:note>
<ns0:note style="-uslm-lc:I74" topic="priorProvisions" id="id9c06918f-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc"><ns0:heading class="centered smallCaps">Prior Provisions</ns0:heading><ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">A prior <ns0:ref href="/us/pl/97/35/s680">section 680 of Pub. L. 97–35</ns0:ref> was classified to <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9909">section 9909 of this title</ns0:ref>, prior to the general amendment of this chapter by <ns0:ref href="/us/pl/105/285">Pub. L. 105–285</ns0:ref>.</ns0:p>
</ns0:note>
<ns0:note style="-uslm-lc:I74" role="crossHeading" topic="statutoryNotes" id="id9c069190-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc"><ns0:heading class="centered"><ns0:b>Statutory Notes and Related Subsidiaries</ns0:b></ns0:heading></ns0:note>
<ns0:note style="-uslm-lc:I78" topic="changeOfName" id="id9c069191-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc">
<ns0:heading class="centered smallCaps">Change of Name</ns0:heading>
<ns0:p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">Committee on Labor and Human Resources of Senate changed to Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions of Senate by Senate Resolution No. 20, One Hundred Sixth Congress, <ns0:date date="1999-01-19">Jan. 19, 1999</ns0:date>.</ns0:p>
</ns0:note>
<ns0:note style="-uslm-lc:I74" topic="miscellaneous" id="id9c069192-86b3-11f1-9949-c831ab2bbedc"><ns0:heading class="centered smallCaps">Procedures To Permit Grant Funds or Intangible Property Acquired by Grant Funds To Become Sole Property of Grantees</ns0:heading><ns0:p><ns0:ref href="/us/pl/119/75/dB/tII">Pub. L. 119–75, div. B, title II</ns0:ref>, <ns0:date date="2026-02-03">Feb. 3, 2026</ns0:date>, <ns0:ref href="/us/stat/140/277">140 Stat. 277</ns0:ref>, provided in part: <ns0:quotedContent origin="/us/pl/119/75/dB/tII">“That the Secretary [of Health and Human Services] shall establish procedures regarding the disposition of intangible assets and program income that permit such assets acquired with, and program income derived from, grant funds authorized under section 680 of the CSBG Act [Community Services Block Grant Act, <ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9921">42 U.S.C. 9921</ns0:ref>] to become the sole property of such grantees after a period of not more than 12 years after the end of the grant period for any activity consistent with section 680(a)(2)(A) of the CSBG Act [<ns0:ref href="/us/usc/t42/s9921/a/2/A">42 U.S.C. 9921(a)(2)(A)</ns0:ref>]: <ns0:i>Provided further</ns0:i>, That intangible assets in the form of loans, equity investments and other debt instruments, and program income may be used by grantees for any eligible purpose consistent with section 680(a)(2)(A) of the CSBG Act: <ns0:i>Provided further</ns0:i>, That these procedures shall apply to such grant funds made available after <ns0:date date="1999-11-29">November 29, 1999</ns0:date>”.</ns0:quotedContent>
</ns0:p>
<ns0:p>Similar provisions were contained in the following prior appropriation acts:</ns0:p>
